title: CoreApiMailSignals
description: Response of GET /mail/:sha256/signals (#469): the phishing signals core stored for one mail message (#207), one entry per stored signal, in core's fixed kind order (spf_fail, dkim_fail, dmarc_fail, display_name_address, reply_to_domain, punycode_domain, mixed_script_domain, lookalike_domain, link_mismatch), then by detail. Empty for a message with no signal. `detail` is untrusted text from the message (a domain, an address, a link's shown and real hosts): the client renders it as escaped plain text, never as a link or HTML. It is absent for the sender-authentication kinds, whose only stored detail is the result word.
